CustomField.description: Formula guard used by AF_FL_Lead_SLAEscalation's entry criteria: true only when OwnerId currently resolves to a User (005 prefix), false when it's a Queue (00G prefix). Salesforce re-checks a record-triggered flow's entry criteria against the record's CURRENT field values when a scheduled path's fire time arrives — if this field is false at that moment (record reassigned back to a queue, or never claimed), the scheduled path is automatically skipped ("neglected") without ever starting the interview, instead of starting and then faulting on a null owner/manager lookup. Added 16 Aug 2026 after RECORD_IN_USE_BY_WORKFLOW was traced to exactly that fault path.
CustomField.label: Is Owner A User
